name: 01-git-head-status.sh
command: bash -c git rev-parse HEAD; echo "---STATUS---"; git status --short | head -n 12; echo "---BRANCH---"; git branch --show-current; echo "---LOG3---"; git log --oneline -3

name: 05-diff-check.sh
command: bash -c git diff --check && echo "diff-check clean"; echo "---WRITE-CHECK---"; git status --short dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_dataset_v1.json results/dataset_audit/ dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_content_du.py dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_content_ctl.py; echo "(empty above = stimulus/audit/content untouched)"; sha256sum dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_dataset_v1.json

name: 06-link-check.sh
command:
bash -c python3 -c "
import re, pathlib
e0=pathlib.Path(\"docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a\")
ok=True
for f in sorted(e0.glob(\"*.md\")):
    txt=f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")
    for m in re.finditer(r\"\]\(([^)#]+)(?:#[^)]*)?\)\", txt):
        tgt=m.group(1)
        if tgt.startswith(\"http\") or tgt.startswith(\"mailto:\") or tgt.startswith(\"#\"):
            continue
        p=(f.parent/tgt).resolve()
        exists=p.exists()
        print(f.name, tgt, \"OK\" if exists else \"MISSING\")
        if not exists: ok=False
print(\"link-check:\", \"PASS\" if ok else \"FAIL\")
"

name: 07-run-outputs.sh
command: bash -c sha256sum docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a/README.md docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a/stimulus-issues.md docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a/stimulus-issues.json docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a/comparisons.md docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a/hashes-start.txt docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a/hashes-end.txt docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a/delivery.diff docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a/logs/01-git-head-status.sh.stdout docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a/logs/02-env.sh.stdout docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a/logs/03-stimulus-scans.sh.stdout docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a/logs/04-targeted-tests.sh.stdout docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a/logs/05-diff-check.sh.stdout docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a/logs/06-link-check.sh.stdout | tee docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a/run-outputs.sha256; echo "---SELF (log only, not in file)---"; sha256sum docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a/run-outputs.sha256 docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a/commands.jsonl
